Standard: Recovery parachute average descent rates do not exceed a vertical velocity of 24 ft/s at sea level on a standard day for the maximum applicable crewmember suspended weight. The recovery parachute provides a selectable gliding and steering capability that is optionally initiated by the ejected crewmember only. The recovery parachute limits horizontal velocity to less than 10 ft/s unless gliding has been selected by the crewmember. The parachute is automatically released upon crewmember entry into seawater. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Demonstration.
(1) The automatic release capability is demonstrated in seawater conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Steady-state descent velocity and steering is verified through full parachute system-level tests.
